svg.title: Shell: run commands in the workspace, with guardrails
svg.desc: The model calls Shell tools: run_command, start_command, check_command and stop_command, or the opt-in shell tool. Before a command runs, its executable is checked against allowed_commands or denied_commands, its shell operators against denied_operators, and interactive commands are blocked; then it runs as a process in the workspace's working directory with only the workspace's environment plus Shell(env=). Four example calls show pytest running and returning labelled output, rm rejected by the default denylist, a dev server started in the background with an ID, and that ID used to check on or stop it.
